title: Vertical Speaker Cut With Captions
tests: Tests portrait reframing combined with accurate, synchronized, readable burned-in speech captions.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.

faults.what: White captions lack a contrasting outline or background and blend into her pale shirt, undermining the requested clear readability.
The opening caption uses a period instead of the required exclamation mark.

judge.summary: The full-length portrait edit centres her successfully and shows the complete wording in chunks, but the captions need stronger contrast.

must_haves.item: The output is a 9:16 edit of the attached footage, with the woman centred and her face fully visible.
must_haves.why: The output frames are 9:16, with her face centred and fully inside the frame.

must_haves.item: The full 10 seconds and original voice are preserved in sync.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound report confirms a 10-second output containing the expected speech, but original-voice preservation and lip sync cannot be verified from stills and a transcript.

must_haves.item: Visible captions reproduce 'Hi everyone! Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.' in order, with no omitted or invented words.
must_haves.why: All words appear in order across the sampled captions; only the opening punctuation differs.

must_haves.item: Captions appear in short readable chunks timed to the corresponding speech rather than displaying the entire transcript throughout.
must_haves.why: The samples progress from the greeting to the middle phrase and then the concluding phrase, rather than showing the entire transcript throughout.

must_haves.item: Captions have clear contrast, stay fully within the frame and do not cover her face.
must_haves.why: They stay inside the frame and below her face, but white lettering over the pale shirt has insufficient contrast.
